author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: AmnesiaStealer targets macOS users through fake GitHub pages, stealing passwords, cookies and data while giving attackers live control of the browser. Jamf Threat Labs researchers disclosed AmnesiaStealer, a new multi-stage Rust-based macOS infostealer that spread through a counterfeit GitHub download page using the ClickFix technique. The lure looks convincing: correct GitHub dark theme, Octocat logo, […]
title: AmnesiaStealer Gives Attackers Live Control of Victims’ macOS Browsers

description: 7.3 million Chess.com profiles leaked online: the data is genuine, but evidence points to large-scale scraping, not a server breach. title: Chess.com Leak Exposes 7.3 Million Users – Evidence Points to Scraping
